response.sql: WITH district_client_counts AS (SELECT d.district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(c.client_id) AS client_count FROM district d INNER JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3), with_totals AS (SELECT district_id, region, client_count, SUM(client_count) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_total, SUM(client_count) OVER () AS overall_total FROM district_client_counts) SELECT district_id, region, client_count, CAST(client_count AS REAL) / region_total AS count_per_region, CAST(client_count AS REAL) / overall_total AS count_per_total FROM with_totals ORDER BY count_per_total DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Only districts with at least one client are included in the result; districts in the district table with no clients are excluded.
